Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants; sign and signal meanings are core knowledge for every new driver.
Why it matters to a first-timer: signal meanings are frequent knowledge-test items [A02], and sign shapes and colors are classic recognition items [A04].
Level: high-volume recognition and recall with a visual component; moderate load, and sign recognition needs pictures rather than words alone.
Prerequisites: the right-of-way, passing and railroad crossing rules from the safe driving rules sections.
